title: My Name Is Jeff
blurb: Channing Tatum, deep undercover in 22 Jump Street, panics and produces the least convincing alias in film history with total commitment. The delivery is confident. The name is obviously wrong. That gap has made the line the internet's favourite way to introduce anybody at all. Play it over a genuine introduction to derail it permanently, or use it yourself in a meeting where nobody has checked the attendee list carefully. Nine years on, people still answer to Jeff without thinking about it.
origin: Channing Tatum's line from 22 Jump Street (2014).
